scope: Preserve opening graph, authoritative repertoire/source definitions and a new verified graph recovery copy; fresh learning state. Historical migration acceptance is superseded.

raw_capture_contract.capture_policy: Complete rows and all columns of exactly these14 required tables. No filters, no broad whole-schema census. Additional captured non-graph columns are incidental PRIVATE recovery facts, never fresh-learning migration requirements.
raw_capture_contract.downstream_projection: Composition adapter supplies existing {tables,graphs}; graphs comes from captured opening_graph_steps whose (repertoire_id,generation) exactly matches selected opening_graph_publications. No raw graph duplication required.
raw_capture_contract.selected_repertoire_ids: Explicit confirmed source IDs in external capture receipt, used for fresh serving projection; raw copy itself has no row filters.
raw_capture_contract.empty_tables: Explicit empty arrays require capture evidence. Missing is not empty.
raw_capture_contract.source_copy_fidelity: Preserve every selected-table column exactly. Raw TEXT JSON/timestamps/FEN are not normalized; source schema metadata/column types are private capture evidence for these tables only.

repertoires.purpose: Repertoire identity, display/source metadata, accepted opening scope and source revision.
repertoires.sql: SELECT * FROM public.repertoires ORDER BY id

repertoire_lines.purpose: Ordered authored routes and complete policy comparison catalogue; FEN alone is not route identity.
repertoire_lines.sql: SELECT * FROM public.repertoire_lines ORDER BY id

repertoire_cards.purpose: Preserve shared membership and explicit source provenance separately from the physical card owner.
repertoire_cards.sql: SELECT * FROM public.repertoire_cards ORDER BY repertoire_id,card_id

cards.purpose: Structural executable/source identity only. Scheduling, reviews and learning exposure are deliberately excluded under fresh-start scope.
cards.sql: SELECT * FROM public.cards ORDER BY id

opening_graph_publications.purpose: Pointer to materialized published generation; state must be checked separately from copy integrity.
opening_graph_publications.sql: SELECT * FROM public.opening_graph_publications ORDER BY repertoire_id

opening_graph_steps.purpose: Accepted materialized route occurrences, physical-card references and complete segment/prefix coverage.

repertoire_line_training_depths.purpose: Existing build_graph uses a truthy override or settings.initial_depth; preserve original zero/null/absence distinctions.
repertoire_line_training_depths.sql: SELECT * FROM public.repertoire_line_training_depths ORDER BY line_id

prefix_splits.purpose: Accepted segmentation overrides, recursively applied by original source_card_id; no review/history transfer.
prefix_splits.sql: SELECT * FROM public.prefix_splits ORDER BY source_card_id

settings.purpose: Only default learner-decision segmentation depth, not old scheduling/preferences.
settings.sql: SELECT * FROM public.settings ORDER BY id

deleted_cards.purpose: Do not regenerate a deliberately removed graph node. Preserve TEXT deleted_at raw in recovery copy; target exclusion uses identity, not a guessed timestamp conversion.
deleted_cards.sql: SELECT * FROM public.deleted_cards ORDER BY card_id

canonical_prefix_previews.purpose: Active accepted scope certificate header. Unreferenced previews/background proposal work are rebuildable and excluded.
canonical_prefix_previews.sql: SELECT * FROM public.canonical_prefix_previews ORDER BY id

canonical_prefix_results.purpose: Conservative complete canonical route certificate/diagnostic source capture; old proposal work is incidental private data, not new target work.
canonical_prefix_results.sql: SELECT * FROM public.canonical_prefix_results ORDER BY preview_id,item_id

canonical_prefix_positions.purpose: Verified route origins for non-starting-position authored lines. line_origin accepts only position.source_revision equal to current repertoire.scope_source_revision.
canonical_prefix_positions.sql: SELECT * FROM public.canonical_prefix_positions ORDER BY preview_id,fen_key,in_scope

opening_graph_legacy_mappings.purpose: Conservative graph source linkage preservation only; never fresh-target historical alias authority.

hash_contract.raw_capture_sha256: SHA-256 of exact raw14table recovery-file bytes; closure.json and external capture receipt are separately bound. Recovery bytes may use the executor existing lossless capture encoding; serialized table input to the transfer validator is {tables:<all14 full row arrays>}. This establishes recovery integrity, not new target acceptance.
hash_contract.existing_source_digest: authority_source_digest(tables), exact existing authority_source_projection in pinned public contracts/game-evidence legacy.py. It intentionally excludes learning schedules/reviews and several source metadata fields; raw file SHA remains required.
hash_contract.existing_graph_digest: authority_graph_digest(graphs): fingerprint of canonically sorted complete 14-field graph projections, preserving TEXT moves_json/decision_fen_keys_json.
hash_contract.existing_catalogue_digest: Reuse route-catalogue digest expression from pinned legacy_game_authority.current_token: fingerprint of routes sorted by id, each {repertoire_id,route_id:id,policy_id:repertoire_id,learner_color:trained_color,starting_fen:start_fen,moves:json.loads(moves_json)}. No old game catalogue generation or authority token is required for fresh graph recovery.
hash_contract.canonical_json: Existing fingerprint uses json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False), UTF-8 SHA-256. Do not substitute parsed-source hashes for exact-byte file hashes.
hash_contract.physical_card_id: Existing tempo_chess_core.card_id: SHA-256(first four supplied FEN fields + newline + space-joined stripped moves). Preserve observed IDs; hash equality does not authorize aliases or pick among transposed routes.
hash_contract.downstream_source_snapshot: Reuse public SourceSnapshot v1 and existing authored_import/content_bridge_export contracts. Preserve exact source.json bytes and import/export digests; do not duplicate their application models.

derivable_or_excluded.materialized_graph: Keep selected accepted publication as recovery evidence even though source routes/depth/splits can rebuild graph structure. New target generations need not impersonate legacy generations.
derivable_or_excluded.nonselected_graph_generations: All are conservatively captured privately in full opening_graph_steps, but only the publication pointer is projected as accepted. Old/staged generations are not reimported as active target work.
derivable_or_excluded.old_background_and_learning: No separate reviews, queues, attempts, receipts, browser stores, teaching, frozen ranks or background task tables. Incidental old scheduling/learning fields in full cards/settings rows remain PRIVATE raw bytes only, not fresh initialization requirements.
derivable_or_excluded.graph_legacy_mappings: Captured privately as an inexpensive full source table; not needed for fresh learning and never used as alias authority.
derivable_or_excluded.prefix_proposals: Full preview/results/positions tables are conservatively captured privately. Only accepted repertoire prefix references and valid origins are behaviorally relevant; old proposal workflows are not restarted.
derivable_or_excluded.integrity_completion: No old integrity state, block/issue rows, scan/task completion or background certificate is transplanted. New graph-only bridge does not use historical aliases; target owner performs fresh graph/route validation before serving.
derivable_or_excluded.learning_target_projection: Learning route/card projection is not a full repertoire-source archive: it omits names/source moves/depth/splits. Independent raw source recovery bundle is required.

capture_confirmation_required: Use existing authorized immutable image/source evidence pinned to86d11afe; no full migration census, both browser identities or historical backup gate.

One authorized REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY snapshot for the14 listed full tables. No row filter. Record same snapshot ID, selected-table column/PK/type shape, source pin and publication/source/prefix tokens in external private receipt.
Confirm explicit fresh-serving repertoire IDs from copied repertoire rows; raw copy includes full repertoire/line catalogue. Do not infer user IDs or colors.

First graph usability checks: publication pointer joins exact generation/owner lines; graph card/parent IDs exist; original shared memberships exist; settings.id1 initial_depth exists; split card IDs exist; deletion exclusions and canonical positions.source_revision are retained.

Check graph-relevant source/FK closure. Incidental non-opening cards may reference study_exercises absent from this capsule; preserve those raw rows privately without adding other-domain tables or reimporting them as opening graphs.
New graph-only recovery copy location plus exact-byte checksums and independent readback/restore validation. No previous full-history backup is a prerequisite.

If source/materialized graph disagree or selected columns are incompatible, retain source bytes and report the exact graph/rebuild issue. Do not fabricate missing identities, use max staged generation or replay old background work.
fresh_target_confirmation_required: Explicit target service/DB identity, workspace, source key and publication-generation/digest binding; do not relabel legacy authority IDs.
Use public graph-only SourceSnapshot/export path with no historical aliases; explicit caller-supplied new due date and normal new-learning initialization.
Preserve every selected authored ordered route, policy color/membership, raw starting FEN and all branch move sequences; exact route coverage validation, not counts alone.

Canonical prefix/verified origins, named route metadata, initial_depth, split overrides, source-only cards and tombstones must remain recoverable in raw bundle. State target behavioral support or missing capability explicitly.
Validate new target staging/activation/operation receipt and readback with target owner. Legacy ready publication/copy checksum is not a new target integrity or activation certificate.
This source-only manifest executes no capture/import/reset/deletion/cutover. Sole authorized capture executor performs any live read; no irreversible deletion is required.
next_executable_slice: Sole live executor captures the14 literal full tables in one read-only consistent snapshot immediately. Transfer owner validates supplied table arrays and receipt, checks graph-relevant FK/publication closure and exact-byte readback, and projects selected existing public source/export inputs. Fresh initialization owner validates new staging/activation/readback without historical transfer.

canonical_source_card_coverage.effective_source_predicate: For selected repertoire R: cards.content_type=opening and archived=0 and (exists repertoire_cards(R,card_id,canonical_route_source=1) OR (cards.repertoire_id=R and cards.canonical_route_source=1 and no explicit repertoire_cards(R,card_id) row)). Explicit owner link with canonical_route_source=0 suppresses fallback.
canonical_source_card_coverage.accepted_occurrences: Report original card IDs and exact observed accepted graphs occurrences (repertoire_id,generation,line_id,decision_index) referencing each ID. Missing occurrence is an uncovered card-only source, not an alias candidate.
canonical_source_card_coverage.supported_route_proof: Existing graph occurrence is evidence only: exact same-repertoire line must exist; original graph executable/color must equal physical source card; supported ordered-route validation must cover the precise executable. Matching FEN/move text alone never establishes the association.
canonical_source_card_coverage.fresh_completeness: Do not apply historical revision=1/alias/schedule gates. If a canonical card-only source cannot be expressed by the supported fresh graph route contract, report its exact source ID privately and retain it in recovery copy; require explicit supported source projection before claiming full fresh source coverage.

downstream_graph_projection.selector: Use selected captured publication.generation exactly, never max(staged generation); preserve failed/missing state honestly.
downstream_graph_projection.shape: Existing public translator graphs array; graph-only fresh adapter may consume routes without historical aliases.
